notes.title: Update 1.2.4
notes.content:
[b]Added[/b]
- New equipment; Archers Vest, Leggings, Wristguard, Quiver.
- Pause button.

[b]Changed[/b]
- Movespeed & Attackspeed changes are now displayed in %.
- Taunt now breaks if another attacker is closer to the target.
- Healing potion now has visual effect.

[b]Fixed[/b]
- Issue with Villager Settings.
- Hurt sound would repeat without delay.
- Removed a confused tree from a cliff.

notes.title: Update v1.2.3
notes.content:
[b]Added[/b]
Healing fountains that can be build within the settlement, restoring health to nearby Villagers.
Structure upgrades: most structures now have upgrades that can be purchased to improve their efficiency.

[b]Fixed[/b]
Healing effects visual effect not showing.
Dera's Firebow range from 0 > 9.

notes.title: Update v1.2.1
notes.content:
[b]Added[/b]
- Added job range limit.
- Added Auto-Harvest option for Farms and Flower Garden.
- Added option to hide minor resource gains from the log.

[b]Changed[/b]
- Reduced cost and efficiency of healing and regeneration potions.
- Changed Taunt trigger chance from 85% to 30%.
- Icons for Carpenter, Farming job, Ragged Shirt, Ragged Pants.

[b]Fixed[/b]
- Audio volume on Draft.
- Missing Stone Sword & Stone Shield recipes from crafting station.

notes.title: Update v1.2.0 - Shops, Hunting & Goblins
notes.content:
- Shops selling various items & resources can be found around the world, can be unlocked through quests, or accessed by other special means.

- New Job: Hunting - Build one of the new hunting structures to set out some bait, assign your Villagers to perform the new Hunting job and hunt from the safety of your settlement.

- The Goblin Warchief has arrived, and with it, new Goblin villages have been constructed in the Sinister Swamps, The Great Forest, and the Desolate Dunes.

- Villager Control Panel: Villager controls such as Equipment, Titles, Jobs, etc. have been moved to the Villager Control Panel, which can be accessed by pressing 'C', or using the button above the journey log.

- World Map: Press 'M' to open the World Map, while blank at first, new pieces can be crafted, traded with scribes, or found in hidden locations.

- Inventory items are now sorted by type.
- New human animations.
- Updated weapon visuals.
- New items, new Quests, new Creatures.
- New secrets to uncover.
- Various bug fixes and quality of life improvements.

notes.title: Villagers & Faith expanded!
notes.content:
- Faith and gods expanded - Shrines can be found around the world, bring offerings to the shrine to receive the god's blessing.

- New legendary items.


- New quests.
Several new quests related to the three gods.

- Villager titles.
Each of your Villagers may be assigned a title, providing unique bonuses for the Villager or your settlement.

- Villager wages.
Villagers don't work for free! Be sure to pay their daily wages or they may become more trouble than they are worth.

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
-Fixed visual issue with Faith rewards.
-Crafting queue limit increased to 5 for all crafting stations.
-Lost Rat quest improved.
-Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
- Fixed issues loading quests.
- Fixed several combat issues.
- Fixed collecting cave resources being repeatable.


Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
- Fixed issue with Trading Post not taking Gold.
- Added control over amount of starting resources.(Requires new game)
- Fps limited to 60.

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
Fixed issue with trading post duplicating items.
Large farm crop growth rate improved.
Reduced Gold cost of some early-game structures.
